features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Efficient Ink Supply System
items.desc: Ensures consistent ink flow to printheads at all times, preventing ink starvation and maintaining uninterrupted production across long print runs.

items.title: Head Crash Protective System
items.desc: Sensor-based protection system safeguards printheads from fabric obstructions during carriage movement, reducing damage risk and extending printhead lifespan.

items.title: Wrinkle Controller System
items.desc: High-precision sensor controls detect and correct fabric surface irregularities in real time, ensuring smooth, uniform media conveying for flawless output.

items.title: 5-Stage Belt Squeeze System
items.desc: Advanced water-resistant squeeze system prevents lint and dust blockage — engineered specifically for high-lint textile production environments, reducing cleaning downtime significantly.

items.title: Linear Motor Precision System
items.desc: Linear motor drives carriage movement with smooth acceleration and positioning accuracy, maintaining ±0.1mm registration across the full 1800mm print width even at production speeds.

items.title: Automatic Capping & Wiping System
items.desc: Keeps printheads clean between runs, preventing ink from drying on nozzles and reducing ink wastage — extending printhead life and ensuring consistent first-drop quality.

items.title: Customizable Drying System
items.desc: Integrated belt + fins heater with adjustable temperature control, optimised for different fabric types — from lightweight silk to heavy cotton and upholstery fabrics.

items.title: One-Touch Maintenance
items.desc: Automated daily maintenance routines minimise operator intervention and keep the machine production-ready with minimal downtime.
